controls.guardMutations: Exact-zero prediction, anonymous slot identity and native case identity guards each compile, fail the intended assertion with original callbacks, and pass after restoration.
controls.transport: Only injected fake responses exercise confidence on API-shaped transports; no external model requests. Actual application-client checks exercise discovery/direct tools without a model turn.
controls.properLosses: Hand-computed arm Brier losses 0.88 and 0.02; exact zero/one certainty errors preserved as infinite-log-loss counts; predictions assigned by frozen case/arm identity rather than randomized execution order.
controls.accounting: Known/unknown completed predictions, missing/rejected/unresolved slots, incomplete retained claims, and conservative finding denominators stay distinct.
controls.independentViews: Candidate metadata removed on all projected output, claim and native target paths; native per-case identities checked before projection; full raw candidates/native receipts remain private operator evidence.

limits.confidence: Host/operator declaration of claim support/scope/actionability; uncalibrated and unauthenticated.
limits.scoring: Only frozen sealed single-claim original synthetic readiness artifacts; multiple completed claims rejected without partial selection.
limits.projection: Structural omission only. Source/hypothesis/operator prose may reveal conditions. Fresh actual host sessions and external attempts remain unverified.
limits.native: Original trusted Node Boolean cases only; no claim about broader mechanism, intended production policy, caller reachability, consequence or remedy.
limits.calibration: No held-out fitting/quality demonstration or model parity claim.
